why: Near miss: Intro to Fusion lesson 10 ("Two STL files are saved, one for the base and one for the lid"). The learner used File > Export on the whole design instead of Save As Mesh on each component, so Fusion wrote one Box.stl holding the base and the lid together, the lid floating 1 mm above the base. A valid, watertight STL, but one file: the lid can't be laid flat and printed on its own.

step.title: Export both parts as STL
step.instructions: Right-click the Base component > Save As Mesh, format STL, and save it in your lesson folder. Do the same for the Lid.
